name: piston-orphan-blocks
comment: Piston blocks without their piston or tile entity, no redstone. A moving block (36) set with set_block has no TileEntityPiston (BlockPistonMoving.onBlockAdded is empty); a right click (use_item, empty hand) removes it (blockActivated, placed true). A right click on a piston base does nothing (BlockPistonBase.blockActivated false). A head (34, meta 1) with stone behind it removes itself at its next neighbour change (BlockPistonExtension.onNeighborBlockChange); a head in front of a retracted piston passes the change on to the piston (nothing happens) and goes when the piston is removed. A neighbour change next to a tile-entity-less moving block does nothing.
